commits.title: fix(api-gateway): count mux traffic as heartbeat liveness
commits.reason: 桌面端长会话靠 mux 通道保活；把 mux 流量计入心跳，避免空闲长会话被当成断连。

commits.title: fix(hmr,skills): contain watcher errors that arrive after close
commits.reason: 桌面宿主长期挂着文件监听；关闭后迟到的 watcher 错误会变成未捕获异常。

commits.title: fix(credentials-local): contain watcher errors that arrive after close
commits.reason: 同族的凭据监听错误兜底，和 HMR/技能监听一起堵住宿主未捕获异常。

commits.title: fix(ui-chat): show a stopped notice for turns interrupted by a DSH stop
commits.reason: 被打断的轮次此前没有可见提示，用户会以为会话卡死；桌面端与 QQ companion 都会打断轮次。

commits.title: fix(session-title): keep the first output line and bound the cap by the request
commits.reason: 会话标题取首行并按请求预算截断，修复多行/超长输出污染标题。

commits.title: fix(web): clip the collapsed right sidebar so PageUp cannot shift the frame
commits.reason: 右侧栏折叠时 PageUp 会把整个框架推走，纯前端布局缺陷。

commits.title: refactor(session-projection): return the exact change-feed disposer
commits.reason: 投影订阅返回精确 disposer，避免多订阅/少退订导致的状态漂移。

discoveryRegistrationInvariant.defect: tool "list_subagent_models" is already registered in this scope
discoveryRegistrationInvariant.introducedBy: this fork only — upstream tool-agent-team has no modelSelectionSettings switch and never registers the discovery tool
discoveryRegistrationInvariant.rootCause: The delegation tool and the Agent Team both registered `list_subagent_models` in the same Agent scope; dsh-tools rejects a second name inside one scope. The shipped package is built into two entry points (lib/index.js bundles list-models inline, lib/list-models.js is standalone), so module-level state was duplicated and never shared.
discoveryRegistrationInvariant.fix: packages/subagent/tool-subagent/src/list-models.ts keeps one registration per scope in a process-wide registry (Symbol.for keyed) and intersects the policies of every contributor; packages/experimental/tool-agent-team/src/index.ts contributes its narrowed policy instead of registering a second time.
discoveryRegistrationInvariant.regressionTest: packages/experimental/tool-agent-team/tests/loader-composition.spec.ts mounts the delegation tool and the Team in one Agent scope; before the fix it failed with the exact reported error.
discoveryRegistrationInvariant.runtimeGate: scripts/check-offline-pack.mjs refuses a payload whose desktop overlay enables modelSelectionSettings while the shipped tool-subagent runtime predates the fix.
